❓ NOTE 3 — Controls

✏️ Pen: draw naturally. 🧽 Eraser: erase strokes by dragging.

🖐️ Palm Eraser: when enabled, a large touch contact is treated as an eraser while writing with a stylus.

↖️ Selection: drag a rectangle around handwriting/shapes. The floating menu stays visible for the selected object(s), so you can move, duplicate, recolor or delete them.

🔷 Shapes: One classroom library contains straight/dotted lines, square, triangle, rectangle, mirrors, optics, maths, physics and chemistry diagrams. Drag to place.

📄 PDF: import at high resolution, write over it, save the lesson, and export the complete board as an HD PDF.

▦ Pages: click the page count to open a professional overview and jump to any page.

Keyboard: Ctrl/Cmd+Z undo • Ctrl/Cmd+Y redo • F full screen • Delete selected objects • Esc close panels.
